scope: Independent protocol review of the completed authorized FP16 storage/runtime precision pair, including original and candidate runtime validation.

authorization_boundary.factors: Same frozen factors as the BF16 arm; no refit or hyperparameter change.
authorization_boundary.candidate_change: Only the same 24 writer tensors are stored in float16; 700 tensors remain source tensors on disk.
authorization_boundary.runtime: Both original and candidate are served sequentially with dtype float16 and otherwise identical flags.
authorization_boundary.mechanisms: No discriminant mask or other learned mechanism is part of this run.

installed_vllm_dtype_review.finding: Qwen3.5 passes the configured model dtype into GatedDeltaNet state dtype selection. The installed FLA chunk path rejects float32 but has no static prohibition on float16, and the GDN path allocates projected/output tensors from the input dtype.
installed_vllm_dtype_review.limit: Source inspection establishes no static FP16 rejection; it does not prove numerical runtime health.

text_health.translation: Correct French translation with no extraneous material.

original_fp16_runtime_audit.server_log_dtype_evidence: Launch recorded dtype=float16 and engine config dtype=torch.float16.
original_fp16_runtime_audit.verdict: PASSED; the original baseline is healthy and the candidate arm may run.

candidate_fp16_runtime_audit.efficacy_verdict: FAILED: fs+ answer reduction was -6.25 percentage points versus the required +25 points.

hard_runtime_gates: The original FP16 arm must finish all 51 calls with the expected model id/root, vLLM 0.23.x, canonical settings/schema and no error, invalid, truncation or nonfinite symptom.
If the original FP16 baseline fails any health condition, stop: candidate behavior is not interpretable.
Fully stop and verify cleanup of the original server before starting the candidate on the same port.
The candidate plan must identify the verified FP16 checkpoint root and use the exact same server and probe settings.
Compare only the new FP16 original baseline with the FP16 candidate via compare.py --original; do not reuse the BF16-runtime baseline.
conclusion: The completed FP16 pair is protocol-valid and structurally healthy. The candidate fails the predeclared selective-efficacy gate and moves fs+ in the wrong direction: answer rate rises from 15/16 to 16/16. No online OSWorld outcome was run.
